title: Expiry Notice Window and Holdover Terms for Beacon Ridge C&I Contracts
content:
These terms apply alike to all six Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts structures: how energy is priced in holdover, the holdover adder, the notice to end holdover, whether ending holdover carries a termination fee, the window in which the expiry notice is issued and the waiver of the adder when that notice was missing or late.

| Term | Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | Block and Index | Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | Fixed All-In | Fixed All-In Renewable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Holdover energy pricing | real-time index plus holdover adder | same | same | same | same | same |
| Holdover adder over the monthly index | 0.85 cents per kWh | 0.85 | 0.85 | 0.85 | 0.85 | 0.85 |
| Notice to end holdover service | 30 calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Early termination fee on ending holdover | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Earliest issue of the expiry notice | 120 calendar days before contract end | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |
| Latest issue of the expiry notice | 60 calendar days before contract end | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Holdover adder not charged when the expiry notice was missing or late | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Points of reading

- Holdover energy is priced at the real-time index plus 0.85 cents per kWh on every structure, including structures that were fixed during the term.
- The expiry notice belongs between 120 and 60 calendar days before the contract end date.
- On every structure the adder is waived when the expiry notice was missing or late, and ending holdover never carries an early termination fee.
